questions.q: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo has been the capital of Japan since 1868.

questions.q: How many continents are there on Earth?
questions.explanation: Earth has 7 continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America.

questions.q: What color is the sky on a clear day?
questions.explanation: The sky appears blue due to sunlight scattering off molecules in the atmosphere.

questions.q: What is the largest mammal on Earth?
questions.explanation: The blue whale is the largest animal known to have ever existed.

questions.q: Which organ pumps blood through the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

questions.q: How many days are in a week?
questions.explanation: There are 7 days in a week.

questions.q: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides by definition.

questions.q: What color is a ripe banana?
questions.explanation: A ripe banana is typically yellow.

questions.q: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
questions.explanation: Neil Armstrong stepped onto the Moon on July 20, 1969.

questions.q: Which continent is the Sahara Desert located on?
questions.explanation: The Sahara Desert spans much of northern Africa.

questions.q: What gas do humans need to breathe to survive?
questions.explanation: Humans need oxygen for cellular respiration.
